observations.text: Enterprise customers are abandoning onboarding when the Salesforce connection requires administrator approval. Customer Success recorded eleven at-risk accounts this month after setup stalled for more than five days.
Support tickets tagged onboarding-blocker increased 38 percent after the April release. Most tickets ask how to map Salesforce fields or recover an expired integration token.

New-customer NPS fell from 41 to 24 among accounts that did not complete CRM setup in their first week. Interview notes repeatedly mention unclear ownership and too many handoffs between Sales Engineering and Customer Success.

projects.title: Project Phoenix: Onboarding Redesign Q2 2023
projects.description: Redesigned enterprise kickoff milestones and introduced a shared Salesforce implementation checklist for the first 30 days.

projects.title: First-Week Activation Sprint Q4 2024
projects.description: Tested triggered education and specialist office hours for customers that missed critical setup milestones.

solutions.title: Guided CRM Setup Recovery Playbook
solutions.description: Use Salesforce milestone data to trigger an Intercom walkthrough after 48 hours of inactivity, then create a Jira escalation for accounts still blocked after five days. Project Phoenix reduced setup-related churn by 19 percent with this sequence.

solutions.title: Onboarding Specialist Office Hours
solutions.description: Invite stalled accounts to twice-weekly specialist sessions through Intercom and record outcomes in Salesforce. The pilot improved activation for attendees but reached only 31 percent of eligible accounts.
